using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace SemanticKernel.Core.TemplateEngine.Blocks.Tests
{
    public class CodeBlockTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task RenderCodeAsync_LogsTrace_WhenTraceEnabled()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(true);

            var blocks = new List<Block>
            {
                new ValueBlock("testValue")
            };

            var codeBlock = new CodeBlock(blocks, "test content", loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // Mark as validated to skip validation error
            var isValid = codeBlock.IsValid(out _);
            Assert.True(isValid);

            var kernelMock = new Mock<Kernel>();

            // Act
            var result = await codeBlock.RenderCodeAsync(kernelMock.Object);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Rendering code:")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private class ValueBlock : Block, ITextRendering
        {
            private readonly string _content;

            public ValueBlock(string content)
                : base(content, null)
            {
                _content = content;
            }

            public override BlockTypes Type => BlockTypes.Value;

            public bool IsValid(out string errorMsg)
            {
                errorMsg = string.Empty;
                return true;
            }

            public string Render(KernelArguments? args)
            {
                return _content;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace SemanticKernel.Core.TemplateEngine.Blocks.Tests
{
    public class CodeBlockTests
    {
        private class DummyBlock : Block
        {
            public DummyBlock(string content, ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory = null) : base(content, loggerFactory) { }
            internal override BlockTypes Type => BlockTypes.Value;
            public override bool IsValid(out string errorMsg)
            {
                errorMsg = string.Empty;
                return true;
            }
        }

        private class DummyTextRenderingBlock : DummyBlock, ITextRendering
        {
            public DummyTextRenderingBlock(string content, ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory = null) : base(content, loggerFactory) { }
            public string Render(KernelArguments? args) => "rendered";
        }

        private class DummyKernel { }

        [Fact]
        public async Task RenderCodeAsync_LogsTrace_WhenTraceEnabled()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(true);

            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var blocks = new List<Block>
            {
                new DummyTextRenderingBlock("dummy", loggerFactoryMock.Object)
            };

            var codeBlock = new CodeBlock(blocks, "dummy content", loggerFactoryMock.Object);

            // Call IsValid to set _validated to true
            bool valid = codeBlock.IsValid(out _);
            Assert.True(valid);

            // Act
            var result = codeBlock.RenderCodeAsync(new DummyKernel());

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Rendering code:")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            await result;
        }
    }
}
